kernels.title: Truthful source-footage recut
avoid_when: the footage cannot support the requested story
human removal would require reconstructing moving scenes

kernels.title: Extracted-frame designed slideshow
best_for: strong still moments inside weak or limited motion
avoid_when: fewer than six meaningfully different usable frames
the intended result requires continuous documentary motion

kernels.title: Full-frame subtitle cleanup and recaption
best_for: preserving vertical framing while replacing burned-in text
avoid_when: the cleanup mask covers the principal subject
more than 20 percent of the frame requires concealment

kernels.title: Clean approved frame then animate
best_for: human or text removal from selected frames
adding restrained motion to approved real scenes
avoid_when: the edit must prove an exact changing condition
the provider cannot preserve scene geometry

kernels.title: Reviewed multi-angle image-to-video assembly
best_for: new reels built from independently accepted generated-motion shots
avoid_when: fewer than five truthful angles exist
generated scenes would be presented as exact documentary proof

kernels.title: Multi-source editorial assembly
avoid_when: source rights or factual citations are unresolved
the narrative lacks enough distinct visual evidence

kernels.title: Localized narration and subtitle variant
best_for: English, Thai, or Chinese versions of an approved visual master
avoid_when: names, claims, or translation cannot be verified
the source timing cannot support the translated script
